senses.gloss:
Have,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓex. by BU 1 P, as 2 P, vft 1 A, vid 4 A (with gen. of possessor); Df 1 P, 10, DA 3 U, Bf 3 U; ‘I h(ave) two sons’ mama putrO staH-vidyete, &c.; ‘he had many sons by Ganga’ gaMgAyAM sa bahUn putrAnudapAdayat.
Ⓑ
 2 (With inf.) by pot. pass. part.; ‘h(ave) to go’ mayA gaMtavyaM.
Ⓑ
 3 prAp 5 P, laB 1 A, A-sad c.; See Get, ‘h(ave) oneʼs own way’ svAtaMtryamavalaMb 1 A, yaTAkAmaM-svarucyA-vft, kAmacArin a. BU.
Ⓑ
 4 (Make) Ex. by causal of verbs; ‘I would h(ave) you go’ tvaM gacCerityahamicCA-mi or tvAM gamayeyaM.
Ⓝ[Hav]ing,Ⓒa.Ⓓex. by the terminations vat, mat, min, in, vin, vala, &c. or by upeta, DArin, yukta, anvita, sanATa, upapanna, Bft in comp.; or by Bah. comp.; ‘h(aving) three eyes’ trilocanaH; Danavat, rajasvala, guRopeta, &c.
Ⓔs.ⒹBogaH, Bukti f., svatvaM, sattA, aDikAraH, vaSaH-SaM, DaraRaM.

Havoc,Ⓒs.ⒹpramATaH, nirdalanaM, nirmaTanaM, vinASaH, vi-pra-DvaMsaH, saMhAraH, ucCedaH, mahApralayaH, mahAviplavaH, saMkzayaH.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹucCid 7 P; See Destroy.
